units.source_text: 于是，穿过村落所需时间，计算起来得扣除三十分钟。

en.t: So, in calculating the time needed to pass through the village, thirty minutes had to be subtracted.

units.source_text: 这片沙地上，时速四公里相当难达到。

en.t: On this stretch of sand, it was quite hard to manage four kilometers an hour.

units.source_text: 沙地上的艰辛，比起脚陷下去，更难受的是，一脚踩上去，白费力气。

en.t: The hardship of walking on sand was not so much that the feet sank in, but that each step wasted its force.
If he tried to run, the waste was even greater.

units.source_text: 倒是大踏步地走好像还比较有效。

en.t: Taking long strides, on the other hand, seemed relatively more effective.

units.source_text: 但同时，作为沙子吸收“力”的补偿，它把脚步声也给吸没了。

en.t: But at the same time, as compensation for absorbing his force, the sand also swallowed up the sound of his footsteps.

units.source_text: 不用去担心脚步声，说它是优点吧，倒也是个优点。

en.t: Since he did not have to worry about footsteps, if one called that an advantage, then it was indeed an advantage.
